outputs.description: Effective indices of the three cladding modes (dual-core model), the corresponding coreless fiber effective indices, and their signed difference delta_n_eff = n_eff - n_eff_coreless, at λ=1.550 µm for the given fiber parameters.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the effective indices (dual-core and coreless) and the field profile for the given geometry, demonstrating the difference between the two models as highlighted in the paper.
